title: EscalationTicket
description: Escalation ticket created when any agent triggers an escalation. Tracks assignment, SLA compliance, resolution, and audit trail. Manual overrides require documented justification.

ticketId.description: Unique escalation ticket identifier. Format: ESC-XXXXXXXX.

alertId.description: Reference to the Clinical Alert that triggered this escalation.

sourceAgent.description: Which agent pillar created this ticket.

escalationType.description: Type of escalation determining the routing destination.

assignedTo.description: Role or specific user ID the ticket is assigned to.

priority.description: Ticket priority. Critical = immediate action required (emergency). High = within SLA. Medium/Low = standard queue.

slaDeadline.description: SLA deadline for response/resolution. Emergency: 5 minutes. Clinical-High: 1 hour. Billing: 24 hours. Standard: 48 hours.

slaBreached.description: True if current time exceeds slaDeadline and ticket is not resolved.

description.description: Detailed description of why escalation was triggered.

overrideJustification.description: REQUIRED if any manual override is applied. Must document the reason. Logged to audit trail per compliance requirement.

performedBy.description: System agent or user ID that performed the action.

auditTrail.description: Immutable audit trail recording every action on this ticket. Required for compliance.

relatedTickets.description: IDs of related escalation tickets (e.g., re-escalation of unresolved issue).

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate ticket creation. Generated from: alertId + sourceAgent + escalationType. System rejects if a matching open ticket already exists.
